# prime-confirmdialog

prime-rs: ConfirmDialog component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/confirmdialog) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-confirmdialog) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/confirmdialog.md)

ConfirmDialog — port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-confirmdialog`.

A modal confirmation window on top of `Dialog`. The app sends a `Confirmation` to the shared `ConfirmationService` (it lives in
the context), and the component shows the confirmations whose `key` matches its own: the header, icon and question text and
the "No" and "Yes" buttons. The close icon, `Escape` and a click on the mask count as a rejection. The window appears only in the browser.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_confirmation::provide_confirmation_service;
use prime_confirmdialog::ConfirmDialog;

Owner::new().with(|| {
    provide_confirmation_service();
    let html = view! { <ConfirmDialog /> }.to_html();
    // while there is no confirmation, there is no window in the markup
    assert!(!html.contains("p-dialog"));
});
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-confirmdialog = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["confirmdialog"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
